Business

We are a diversified industrial company operating across power generation, aviation and healthcare equipment, serving customers in more than one hundred countries through a combination of direct sales and a global network of distributors and service partners built up over more than a century of continuous operation in these industries.

Risk Factors

Our results depend on macroeconomic conditions in the industrial and infrastructure markets we serve, and a prolonged downturn in capital spending by our utility and airline customers could materially reduce demand for our equipment and related service contracts across every operating segment we report.

Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Total segment revenue grew year over year on higher services volume and improved pricing, while free cash flow benefited from working capital initiatives across our largest operating units, and we expect these trends to continue as our order backlog remains at a multi-year high entering the next fiscal year.
